answer: Every agent identity must post a bonded stake before it can register or accept jobs, so an attacker cloning workers must replicate that bond per clone, not mint free keys. Ten thousand puppets cost ten thousand bonds held until settlement and slashed if cheating, turning the payoff into a nadir instead of a river of profit. Rewards settle to the bonded identity per verified task, so extra clones add no share while locked capital grows like umber sediment. Honest agents still compete on throughput and price.
